summary: Upexi, Inc. furnished an 8-K on September 9, 2026 (event date September 8, 2026) disclosing a press release that Chief Strategy Officer Brian Rudick will attend investor meetings at the FT Partners FinTech Conference 2026 on September 15, 2026, at Convene, 601 Lexington Avenue, New York. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date is stated. The filing is furnished under Item 8.01 and Exhibit 99.1, so it is not deemed filed for Section 18 or Section 11 liability purposes. This is ordinary investor-relations activity, not a special situation; no deal terms exist to trade against.
